title: Convex dynamic online optimization with an unknown path budget and one-gradient feedback
summary: One learner must adapt to all comparator paths without knowing path length in advance. Losses are convex with bounded gradients, and path length is Euclidean. Each round reveals only the gradient at the chosen action.

operations.query_signature: Submit the final master action $x_t\in X$ and receive one exact gradient there. Internal experts do not query gradients at their own actions. Euclidean projection onto $X$ is allowed. The policy is causal and independent of the comparator and path budget. Inputs $T,X,D,G$ are public; path $u_{1:T}$ and its Euclidean length are hidden. Past feedback may be stored and reused computationally; no additional historical or sample queries are available beyond the explicitly declared interface.
